text: This is the Be Bodywise Results Companion, a working prototype built for the Mosaic Fellowship.

In customer conversations, the same gap kept coming up. People bought the right product, but weren't sure how much to use, how often, or how long to wait before judging it. The Companion covers that whole stretch: choosing, understanding, following, and evaluating a routine.
It starts with the Fit Finder. A customer picks what they want help with, and only the questions relevant to those answers appear.
Here, someone wants help with dark underarms and hair thinning. Answers about hair removal and age add the right cautions, like avoiding freshly shaved skin.
Before seeing results, they can review and change any answer.
Every suggestion explains why it fits and what to keep in mind. The rules are transparent, and red-flag answers point to a doctor instead of a product.
Decode My Product turns each product page into a plain-language guide.

Every detail carries its source: the brand page, a retailer listing, general guidance, or check the label. Where the brand's own pages disagree, as they do on how often to use this serum, the guide says so.
Timelines and precautions appear exactly as the brand states them, never as promises.
And where information couldn't be verified, the app says so, instead of guessing.
My Results Journey records where a customer started, so they don't give up on a product too early.
This synthetic example started five weeks ago. The timeline shows check-ins, the brand's own milestones, and a review point at week twelve.
A check-in takes a few seconds. The app keeps reported consistency, the customer's own impression, and measured results separate, and it doesn't pretend to measure anything.
Next steps respond to the answers: here, a link back to the guide, and a reminder that no change yet is normal at week five.
The Routine Coach answers everyday questions. It isn't a live AI model. It runs on a built-in knowledge base of product information, and it says so on screen.
Ask how often to use the serum, and the answer comes with its source.
Missed a day? It says not to double up.
If someone reports redness or burning, safety comes first: stop using the product, rinse gently, and see a doctor if it doesn't settle. Severe symptoms are sent straight to emergency care.
Around these sit smaller tools. A daily checklist, with no streaks and no guilt about missed days.
Quick Answers searches common questions.
Myth Buster corrects common mistakes, like using more product to get faster results.
And optional reminders appear inside the app only. Nothing is sent to your phone.
Choose with reasons. Use with clarity. Judge results at the right time. That's the Be Bodywise Results Companion.
